options.text: Roughage and water are needed in the diet even though they are not classed as nutrients.
Roughage carries waste out of the body through sweat and urine.
One sip of water on the trek is enough for nutrient absorption and waste removal.
Cucumber peels contain no roughage because they look smooth.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Charu packs cucumber peels for roughage and a bottle of water for a trek. She knows proteins and fats are nutrients. She asks whether roughage and water still belong in the diet.

part_answers.answer: The body needs roughage and water for waste removal and absorption even though they are not nutrients.

teacher.key_rationale: Roughage and water are essential diet components though not nutrients. Roughage does not leave via sweat; one sip is not enough; smooth peels still have fibre.
